name: El/La Para TransLatinas
description: Free case management, immigration support, and advocacy for trans Latinx people
fullDescription: El/La Para TransLatinas provides peer advocacy, case management, HIV prevention, violence prevention, and emergency support for trans, intersex, and gender-diverse Latinx people in the San Francisco Bay Area.
whatTheyOffer:
- Case management and resource navigation (housing, legal help, healthcare, IDs)
- Immigration support, including asylum support letters
- HIV prevention education and peer support
- Violence prevention and wellness programs
- Direct financial assistance
- Leadership, entrepreneurship, and workforce programs (Luchadorxs, TransLatinx Workforce)
- Outreach and advocacy
howToGetIt:
1. Call El/La at 415-864-7278 or message them on Facebook Messenger (@ellaparatranslatinas)
2. Make an appointment for services
3. Check the monthly program calendar for workshops and events
4. Join community groups and programs
keywords: El/La Para TransLatinas, San Francisco, transgender, trans Latina, Latinx, intersex, immigration, case management, HIV prevention, violence prevention, financial assistance, workforce, leadership
